docRequirement: keybindings.md:9 binds us to a user-editable keybindings configuration file, discoverable through a command: "Claude Code supports customizable keyboard shortcuts. Run `/keybindings` to create or open your configuration file at `~/.claude/keybindings.json`." The file's shape is fixed by :13-38 — an object with optional `$schema` and `$docs` plus a `bindings` array whose blocks each carry a `context` string and a `bindings` map of keystroke -> action; actions are spelled `namespace:action` (:71, e.g. `chat:externalEditor`); a keystroke mapped to `null` unbinds the default (:395); chords are space-separated keystroke sequences (:378-382) and a chord prefix stays reserved until every chord sharing it is unbound (:410); modifiers are `ctrl`/`control`, `shift`, `alt`/`opt`/`option`/`meta`, `cmd`/`command`/`super`/`win` joined with `+` (:354-357), a standalone uppercase letter implies Shift while an uppercase letter with a modifier does not (:372-374); the file reloads live — "Changes to the keybindings file are automatically detected and applied without restarting Claude Code" (:15); and the loader must warn on parse errors, invalid context names, reserved-shortcut conflicts, multiplexer conflicts and duplicate bindings in the same context, writing each warning to the debug log (:470-480).
current: No keybindings file, loader, schema or command exists. `grep -rna keybindings` over `apps/electron/src`, `apps/cli/src` and `packages/*/src` returns only the internal `keybinding-context.ts` when-clause helper and one unrelated doc quote (`packages/shared/src/config/safe-mode.ts:9`); `grep -rna "keybindings.json"` over the repo (excluding node_modules/.git/.references) returns nothing outside bundled third-party assets. The whole mechanism is an in-memory stub: `apps/electron/src/renderer/actions/registry.tsx:23` is the comment `// User hotkey overrides (future: load from config)`, :24 declares `userOverrides: Map<ActionId, string | null>` on the context type, :31 creates it as `useRef(new Map())`, and :61-62 / :116 are its only reads — `grep -rna userOverrides` over all .ts/.tsx returns exactly those five hits, so it is never written and `getHotkey` (:59-65) always falls through to `actions[actionId].defaultHotkey`. The action vocabulary is dotted, not colon-spelled: `apps/electron/src/renderer/actions/definitions.ts` declares 27 ids such as `app.newChat` (:7), `nav.focusChat` (:79), `view.toggleSidebar` (:126), `navigator.selectAll` (:153), `chat.stopProcessing` (:191). There is no context vocabulary at file level: `apps/electron/src/renderer/actions/types.ts:1` `ActionScope = 'global' | 'navigator' | 'chat' | 'sidebar'` is set by only three definitions (definitions.ts:158, :166, :197) and no code reads `.scope`; the live gate is the `when` clause (types.ts:16) evaluated by `evaluateWhen()` (`apps/electron/src/renderer/actions/keybinding-context.ts:125-144`) against a six-key `KeybindingContext` (:18-31 — inputFocus, hasSelection, chatFocus, navigatorFocus, sidebarFocus, menuOpen). The keystroke grammar is narrower than the page's: `matchesHotkey` (registry.tsx:138-177) lowercases the hotkey and splits on a single `+`, understands only `mod`, `shift`, `alt` (:141-143, `mod` = Cmd on macOS / Ctrl elsewhere via :145), has no chord/pending-prefix state at all (`grep -rna -i chord` over src finds only the prose comment at definitions.ts:138), and its `toLowerCase()` at :139 destroys the `K` = `shift+k` rule. `null` is already the unbound sentinel end-to-end (types.ts:7, registry.tsx:31, :61-62, and the keydown loop's `if (!hotkey || ...) continue` at :88), so the data model would honour an unbind — there is simply no file to write one in. Both display surfaces are read-only renderers of `actionsByCategory`: `apps/electron/src/renderer/pages/settings/ShortcutsPage.tsx:138-146` and `apps/electron/src/renderer/components/KeyboardShortcutsDialog.tsx:161-167`, each reaching the hotkey through `useActionLabel` -> `getHotkeyDisplay` -> `getHotkey` (`apps/electron/src/renderer/actions/useHotkeyLabel.ts:26-34`), with no editing or persistence. No `/keybindings` command: the `SlashCommandId` union at `apps/electron/src/renderer/components/ui/slash-command-menu.tsx:17` has no such member and the `featureCommands` list (:220ff) has no entry. Scope note: the page is terminal-TUI-shaped, and `apps/cli` has no interactive key surface to rebind — `grep -rna -E "setRawMode|createInterface|keypress|process\.stdin"` over `apps/cli/src` finds only a TTY probe at `apps/cli/src/index.ts:427` — so the only comparable surface is the Electron renderer registry.
divergence: This is an absent mechanism, not a wrong key name. Four separable deltas: (1) NO CONFIG FILE OR LOADER — nothing reads a `keybindings.json`, so the declared `userOverrides` map (registry.tsx:31) is permanently empty and no user can rebind anything by any route; the doc's `$schema`/`$docs`/`bindings` object, its `context` blocks, and the live-reload requirement (:15) have no counterpart. (2) VOCABULARY SPELLING — the concept of a namespaced action id exists but uses a dot (`app.newChat`) where the page uses a colon (`app:newChat`, :71); the file-level `context` names (:45-65, nineteen of them) have no counterpart at all — our nearest analogue is the six-key `when`-clause context (keybinding-context.ts:18-31), and even the four-value `ActionScope` is dead metadata. (3) KEYSTROKE GRAMMAR — our parser accepts `mod|shift|alt` only (registry.tsx:141-143) against the page's `ctrl|control`, `shift`, `alt|opt|option|meta`, `cmd|command|super|win` (:354-357); it has no chord sequencing (:378-382) and no prefix reservation (:410); and its blanket `toLowerCase()` (:139) cannot express the `K` = `shift+k` / `ctrl+K` = `ctrl+k` asymmetry (:372-374). (4) NO DISCOVERY OR VALIDATION — no `/keybindings` command entry (slash-command-menu.tsx:17) and none of the five documented warning classes (:470-480). What is already right and must not be re-derived: `null` as the unbound sentinel, the override-before-default precedence in `getHotkey` (registry.tsx:59-65), and a single capture-phase dispatcher the overrides feed into (:80-108).

change.what: New module, modelled on packages/shared/src/config/preferences.ts:45 (`const PREFERENCES_FILE = join(CONFIG_DIR, 'preferences.json')`). Declare `KEYBINDINGS_FILE = join(CONFIG_DIR, 'keybindings.json')` (CONFIG_DIR from ./paths.ts:21, i.e. ~/.nessy-agent) and the doc's exact shape: `{ $schema?: string; $docs?: string; bindings: Array<{ context: KeybindingContextName; bindings: Record<string, string | null> }> }`. `loadKeybindings()` returns `{ overrides: Map<string, string | null>, warnings: KeybindingWarning[] }` and must INVERT the direction: the file is keystroke -> action, the registry map is action -> keystroke. Two consequences to implement explicitly — an entry whose value is `null` (`"ctrl+u": null`, doc :34/:395) names a KEYSTROKE, so the loader must resolve it against the default table to find which action currently holds that keystroke in that context and emit `action -> null`; and one action bound in two contexts needs a decision (recommended: last block wins, plus a duplicate warning) because the target map is keyed by action alone. Accept the doc's colon spelling as the canonical file vocabulary and translate `app:newChat` -> `app.newChat` on load so a Claude user's file works; reject unknown ids with a warning rather than silently dropping. Emit the five documented warning classes (:470-480), minus multiplexer conflicts which have no meaning in a desktop shell — record that omission in the module header per the repo's deviation convention.

Enumerate the accepted `context` values and validate against them (doc :45-65 lists nineteen). Only the ones with a real surface here can be honoured — Global, Chat, Autocomplete (the slash menu), Settings, Confirmation, Tabs, Help, Attachments, MessageSelector, DiffDialog, ModelPicker, Select, Plugin — and each must map to a `when`-clause expression evaluable by `evaluateWhen()` (apps/electron/src/renderer/actions/keybinding-context.ts:125). The terminal-only contexts (Transcript, HistorySearch, Task, ThemePicker, Footer, Scroll) have no counterpart: accept-and-warn rather than hard-error, so a shared file from a Claude user still loads. Several of these contexts need new `KeybindingContext` keys beyond today's six (:18-31) — that is the bulk of the work, not the file parsing.

Populate the map. Replace the `useRef(new Map())` at :31 (and delete the `// future: load from config` comment at :23) with state loaded from the new RPC read, and re-run it on the file-changed push so :15's live reload holds. Note a trap: `getHotkey` is a `useCallback` with `[]` deps reading `userOverrides.current` at call time, so the keydown loop (:86-102) would pick up a mutated ref immediately, but every rendered label goes through `getHotkeyDisplay` during render and would go STALE — the loaded overrides must therefore live in React state (or carry a version counter in the context value at :110-117), otherwise hot reload silently only half-applies.

Extend the parser at :138-177 to the documented grammar. Add the modifier aliases `ctrl`/`control`, `alt`/`opt`/`option`/`meta`, `cmd`/`command`/`super`/`win` alongside the existing `mod` (:141-143), keeping `mod` as our own platform-relative spelling. Handle the uppercase rule before lowercasing (:139 currently destroys it): a bare `K` implies Shift, `ctrl+K` does not. Add chord support: split the hotkey on spaces, and hold a pending-prefix timer in the provider so `ctrl+x ctrl+e` resolves and an unmatched prefix keystroke is swallowed while any chord on that prefix is still live (:378-382, :410). Chords are the one piece with no seam today — everything else is an extension of existing branches.

Add a `keybindings: { READ: 'keybindings:read', WRITE: 'keybindings:write' }` block next to `preferences` (:253-256), plus a CHANGED push channel for live reload (see packages/shared/src/protocol/events.ts:34 for the push-event typing pattern). This is a wire-boundary change — a risk trigger under AGENTS.md.

Add the keybindings twins directly below, copying the existing shape verbatim: READ returns `{ content, exists }` with `{ content: '{}', exists: false }` when absent (:280-286); WRITE `JSON.parse`-validates, mkdirs and writes (:289-299). Return the loader's warnings alongside the content so the UI can surface them rather than only the debug log.

Add `<CONFIG_DIR>/keybindings.json` to the watched set and to the header enumeration at :1-20 (which already lists config.json, preferences.json, hooks.json, theme.json). Fire the CHANGED push on write so :15's "applied without restarting" is satisfied through the existing mechanism rather than a second watcher.

Add `readKeybindings`/`writeKeybindings` invoke entries in the same block. `apps/electron/src/transport/__tests__/channel-map-parity.test.ts` enforces parity between this map and the ElectronAPI surface, so both edits must land together.
Declare `readKeybindings(): Promise<{ content: string; exists: boolean }>` and `writeKeybindings(content: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }>` beside the preferences pair.

Add `'keybindings'` to the union and a `keybindingsCommand` entry, then wire the handler to create-or-open ~/.nessy-agent/keybindings.json — the `memory` command's open-a-file path is the closest precedent. This is the doc's discovery half (:9) and it is one union member plus one const plus a handler branch.
Add the new command label/description and the validation-warning strings to EVERY locale file; `bun run lint:i18n:parity` and `lint:i18n:sorted` gate this.

The quoted contract in this file's own header (:7-17) names "custom keybindings" among what safe mode must not load, and the constant's 11 entries do not include it. Gate `loadKeybindings()` behind `isSafeModeEnabled()` (:99) and decide whether a 12th surface row belongs here — `packages/server-core/src/bootstrap/__tests__/safe-mode-capability-gate.test.ts:163` asserts the length is 11, so the constant cannot grow without that test. Note that keybindings do NOT flow through `buildCapabilityResolutionInputsV2` (packages/server-core/src/bootstrap/storage-runtime.ts:630), so the single-funnel gate does not cover them for free.

blastRadius: Crosses a wire boundary and a persistence boundary, both AGENTS.md risk triggers. Wire: a new RPC channel pair in packages/shared/src/protocol/channels.ts consumed by packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/settings.ts and apps/electron/src/transport/channel-map.ts, with apps/electron/src/transport/__tests__/channel-map-parity.test.ts and apps/electron/src/shared/__tests__/ipc-channels.test.ts enforcing the surface. Persistence: a new user-owned file in CONFIG_DIR (packages/shared/src/config/paths.ts:21) — hand-edited, so it must survive a malformed write without breaking startup, and the watcher (packages/shared/src/config/watcher.ts) gains a path. Every consumer of an action hotkey inherits the change for free and must be re-checked for staleness rather than re-plumbed: `getHotkeyDisplay` feeds `useHotkeyLabel`/`useActionLabel` (apps/electron/src/renderer/actions/useHotkeyLabel.ts:14-34), which drive apps/electron/src/renderer/pages/settings/ShortcutsPage.tsx:138-146, apps/electron/src/renderer/components/KeyboardShortcutsDialog.tsx:161-167 and every tooltip using the hook. `ActionRegistryProvider` has four mount sites (apps/electron/src/renderer/App.tsx, apps/electron/src/renderer/playground/registry/session-list.tsx, apps/electron/src/renderer/playground/demos/mobile-webui/MobilePlaygroundProviders.tsx) — the playground mounts must keep working without an IPC bridge, so the loader has to be injectable/defaultable. The chord work touches the single capture-phase `keydown` listener (registry.tsx:106) that all 27 actions share, so a pending-prefix bug swallows keystrokes app-wide; the actions directory has exactly one test file today (apps/electron/src/renderer/actions/__tests__/keybinding-context.test.ts), so the parser and the loader both need new coverage. Safe mode couples in (see the change list). Imported-plugin paths are NOT affected — keybindings are not a plugin component type in plugins-reference.md, and nothing in the adapters reads them.
userImpact: A user cannot rebind any keyboard shortcut in Nessy Desktop, and there is no surface that tells them so. Settings -> Shortcuts (ShortcutsPage.tsx) and the Cmd+/ Keyboard Shortcuts dialog both render the 27 defaults as static `<kbd>` chips with no edit affordance and no link to a config file; typing `/keybindings` in the composer matches no command. Concretely: `mod+q` is hardwired to app.quit, `escape` to chat.stopProcessing, `mod+a` to navigator.selectAll — a user whose muscle memory or accessibility setup needs a different chord has no route, and a user arriving from Claude Code who drops a `~/.claude/keybindings.json`-shaped file anywhere sees it silently ignored (no warning, no debug line). It also blocks the one workaround for a known collision already recorded in the code: definitions.ts:136-139 documents that view.toggleTaskChecklist had to move off Claude's Ctrl+T because app.newChatInPanel owns mod+t — with a keybindings file the user could resolve that themselves.
notes: Read in full or over the cited ranges: registry.tsx, types.ts, definitions.ts, keybinding-context.ts, index.ts, useHotkeyLabel.ts (all of apps/electron/src/renderer/actions/), settings/ShortcutsPage.tsx, KeyboardShortcutsDialog.tsx, slash-command-menu.tsx:1-60 and :130-235, packages/shared/src/config/{paths.ts:1-40, preferences.ts:1-60, watcher.ts:1-50, safe-mode.ts:1-40 and :68-100}, packages/shared/src/protocol/channels.ts:248-260, packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/settings.ts:270-300, apps/electron/src/transport/channel-map.ts:200-210, apps/electron/src/shared/types.ts:620-630, and the raw doc page (curl of keybindings.md, 480 lines — never WebFetch). Absence claims all used `grep -rna`. Two things I did NOT verify and that the implementer should settle first: (a) which of the doc's nineteen contexts have a live analogue is my reading of the surfaces, not a per-dialog audit — I did not open the Confirmation/ModelPicker/Plugin dialog components to confirm each has a keyboard path the registry could own, and that audit is the real sizing risk behind the L; (b) whether the 11-entry SAFE_MODE_SUPPRESSED_SURFACES omission of keybindings/themes/statusline/file-suggestion commands is itself a filed divergence elsewhere in the sweep — I read the constant and the test asserting its length, but did not search the other findings, so the safe-mode row may belong to another spec rather than this one. Also worth recording alongside the row: apps/cli has no raw-mode key handling at all, so roughly half the page (reserved terminal keys, tmux/screen prefixes, vim-mode interaction, the Scroll/Transcript/HistorySearch contexts) has no surface in this fork to diverge on; the customization mechanism itself is what is missing, and registry.tsx:23 already self-declares it as future work.
